text: At the invitation of the Confronting Anti-Black Racism Unit, Social Development, Finance and Administration, the Executive Director and the Chief Advocacy Officer, Parents of Black Children Community Group, and a representative from the Black Legal Action Centre, will give a presentation on various issues, including initiatives to support improved civic rights and knowledge of Black immigrants and the use of disaggregated race based data collection and anti-Black racism curriculum in Toronto schools.
The Confronting Anti-Black Racism Advisory Committee received the item for information.
